description: Runs Rhai workflow scripts that orchestrate background agents, as a plugin with a read-only worker persona.

inference_slots.description: Runs the agent steps of a workflow with read-only files and shell. Any capable profile.
inference_slots.name: wf_read_only

name: rhai_workflows

bind_dir.description: A .rhai workflow file, or a folder of them, to check or run

plugins.description: Runs Rhai workflow scripts that orchestrate background agents.

agent_budget.description: Most agents the run may start, 1 to 1024; on resume or answer it raises the budget. Leave out unless the user gives a number; `--budget <n>` in argv says the same.

args.description: The workflow's inputs, as an object.

argv.description: Verb and operands, for example ["run", "<name>", "--budget", "3"] or ["resume", "<key|handle>"]. Start with ["help"].

path.description: Absolute path of a .rhai file or folder to check or run. Leave out otherwise.

script.description: Source text of a new script, starting with `let meta = #{`. Never a name or a file: a saved workflow runs with argv ["run", "<name>"] and no script. Leave out otherwise.

plugins.name: workflow
